motivation.purpose: Personality trait distributions and behavioral priors for persona simulation.
motivation.domain: MBTI personality types and social writing samples
research_questions: Can personality trait priors inform realistic persona behavioral constraints?

composition.instance_type: MBTI type label with 50 writing sample posts
composition.slice_description: Test split of cleaned MBTI dataset
composition.sensitive_content: Public forum posts; self-reported personality classifications.

collection.collection_mechanism: Scraped public PersonalityCafe forum posts tagged with self-reported MBTI types.

preprocessing.cleaning_applied: Clean URLs and noise; extract type classification and representative posts.

intended_uses: Optional personality trait priors for persona engine in Phase 8.
prohibited_uses: Commercial redistribution without upstream license compliance
